name: Root canal treatment
summary: How expats arrange root canal treatment in Singapore — endodontist vs general dentist, pain triage, insurance dental riders, and travel timing after treatment.
body:
Root canal therapy saves an infected tooth when decay or trauma reaches the pulp. General dentists handle straightforward canals; endodontists take complex or retreatment cases with microscopes and CBCT.

## Decision points
- Emergency pain relief vs definitive canal therapy
- General dentist vs endodontist referral
- Crown timing after the canal is filled
- Dental rider / corporate panel limits
- Flying after treatment if swelling risk remains

Same-day emergency slots fill fast around long weekends.

## How to choose
Prefer clinicians who show the radiograph and explain canal anatomy before quoting. Ask whether the fee includes the final crown or only the canal. Confirm after-hours contacts if pain flares overnight.

## Practical tip
Save the tooth number and radiograph image on your phone. Switching clinics mid-treatment without records wastes appointments.
